destination.title: Higher-dimensional cosmology and effective descriptions
destination.question: How do extra dimensions, branes and their effective descriptions generate or constrain cosmological evolution and observable gravity?
destination.summary: No original scientific scope statement accompanies the numerical membership, so its original scope cannot be affirmed independently. The proposed family connects cosmological constructions, obstruction tests, stabilization and gravitational phenomenology without treating them as equivalent questions.

systems: Compactifications of gravity, supergravity and string/M-theory
Braneworlds, moving branes and induced gravity
Radion, dilaton and other effective cosmological fields
targets: Acceleration, de Sitter geometry and dynamical dark energy
Inflationary observables and subsequent cosmological evolution
Effective gravity, matter localization, bounces and dimensional selection
regimes: Static and evolving internal geometries remain distinct
Finite compact volume, noncompact directions and infinite-volume induced gravity remain distinct
Early cosmology and late dark energy
Asymptotic control and finite large-modulus control
assumptions: Energy conditions, truncations and stabilization assumptions are source-specific
A construction question does not establish existence, stability or observational viability
Swampland-related conjectures are optional source-local hypotheses
conventions: Keep Einstein-frame, induced-metric and matter-observer statements distinct
Use each source's gravitational-scale definition and dimensionality
includes: Lower-dimensional reductions and nonaccelerating vacuum or gravity questions when explicitly connected
Critiques and conditional counterexamples to proposed restrictions
excludes: Any universal obstruction inferred from numerical proximity
Automatic equivalence of questions sharing a mechanism or paper
Thermal extrema, complex-field convergence and generic singularity billiards as established acceleration mechanisms
The independent aether/electromagnetism target as an established dark-energy mechanism

sources.title: Towards an Explicit Model of D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: How can D3 motion, warped geometry and nonperturbative volume stabilization share a four-dimensional Einstein-frame description? A fiducial metric fixes the reference throat, while the breathing mode records the volume response to brane displacement.

sources.title: Inflation from wrapped branes

evidence.text: How does the warped compactification geometry constrain canonical inflaton displacement in units of the four-dimensional gravitational scale?

sources.title: De Sitter brane-world, localization of gravity, and the cosmological constant

evidence.text: Can warped cosmological brane-worlds support de Sitter expansion, finite four-dimensional Newton coupling and a localized massless graviton despite a noncompact extra direction? How do expansion and bulk cosmological curvature modify Planck-mass reduction formulas?

sources.title: Accelerating internal dimensions and nonzero positive cosmological constant

evidence.text: Can an adopted self-tuning mechanism yield a small positive cosmological constant while determining the internal scale and dilaton through four-dimensional dynamics, without KKLT nonperturbative stabilization?

sources.title: Expanding Universe and Dynamical Compactification Using Yang-Mills Instantons

evidence.text: Can Yang–Mills instantons in four extra dimensions drive accelerated expansion of four-dimensional spacetime together with contraction of the internal space, without introducing an independent inflaton and an ad hoc inflation potential?

sources.title: Time-dependent compactification to de Sitter space: a no-go theorem

evidence.text: Can smooth, time-dependent compactifications produce exact de Sitter spacetime in the lower-dimensional Einstein frame while satisfying higher-dimensional energy conditions, when that frame condition is imposed only after integration over the compact space?

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: Can time-dependent warped compactifications satisfy quantum-corrected Einstein equations while preserving the type IIB de Sitter metric and a useful expansion hierarchy?

sources.title: Regular Black Hole Interior Spacetime Supported by Three-Form Field

evidence.text: Can the fixed-sphere, expanding-dS2 behavior motivate higher-dimensional compactification or an effective reduction of spacetime dimensions at high curvature? Could a related mechanism illuminate de Sitter cosmology despite negative matter potentials?

sources.title: de Sitter in non-supersymmetric string theories: no-go theorems and brane-worlds

evidence.text: What effective potential governs an external radion and dilaton after reducing a higher-dimensional gravity–dilaton theory on a compact internal space with magnetic flux?

sources.title: Dimensional reduction and (Anti) de Sitter bounds

evidence.text: How do gravitational, scalar, and particle parameters transform when one circle is compactified while retaining the radion?

sources.title: Hyperbolic compactification of M-theory and de Sitter quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can negatively curved M-theory compactifications support controlled four-dimensional accelerated expansion through curvature, Casimir energy and flux, while stabilizing internal metric and form-field deformations?

sources.title: Aether, dark energy and string compactifications

evidence.text: Can D-branes realize a Lorentz-compatible aether supporting electromagnetism, and can string/M-theory compactifications accommodate dark energy through time-dependent cosmologies with accelerated expansion?

sources.title: Emergent de Sitter cosmology near black hole horizon

evidence.text: Can a brane near a five-dimensional black-hole horizon support an effective four-dimensional de Sitter cosmology, with induced gravity, matter-dependent stabilization and a finite lifetime compatible with Trans-Planckian Censorship?

sources.title: Asymptotic accelerated expansion in string theory and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can fixed-flux scalar runaways at infinite moduli-space distance support accelerated expansion while remaining within an asymptotic effective description?

sources.title: Interpreting the Cosmic History of the Universe Through Five-Dimensional Supergravity

evidence.text: Can a single five-dimensional supergravity brane model describe inflation, deceleration and late-time acceleration without a separate inflaton or a cosmological constant on the brane?

sources.title: Generalization of instanton-induced inflation and dynamical compactification

evidence.text: Can internal Yang–Mills instantons drive external expansion and dynamical compactification when the internal Einstein geometry and FLRW spatial curvature are generalized, and which geometries permit homogeneous cosmology or bouncing solutions?

sources.title: Constant curvature 3-branes in 5-D f(R) bulk

evidence.text: Can quadratic higher-curvature gravity in a warped five-dimensional bulk support curved branes and generate a radion potential with both metastable and stable minima? The paper also asks whether this setting permits bouncing cosmology and satisfies its stated swampland restriction.

sources.title: Large extra dimensions from higher-dimensional inflation

evidence.text: Can uniform higher-dimensional inflation generate large compact dimensions and weak four-dimensional gravity while solving the horizon problem, producing acceptable primordial perturbations, and allowing subsequent radion stabilization?

sources.title: Extra Dimensions Beyond the Horizon

evidence.text: Can a compact extra dimension extending beyond a nonsingular bulk horizon geometrically relate the Planck–cosmological-constant hierarchy, preserve causal gravitational dynamics, and support realistic brane cosmology?

sources.title: Black hole-de Sitter model, a proposal for the de Sitter phases

evidence.text: Can a brane near a five-dimensional black-hole horizon acquire an effective de Sitter geometry whose singled-out cosmological term has no explicit dependence on brane tension or bulk cosmological constant, and can bulk energy flux drive its cosmological evolution?

sources.title: Warped dimensions at the cosmological collider

evidence.text: Can a warped extra dimension remain stabilized during inflation with KK scale Λ ∼ H, allowing its radion and KK gravitons to produce observable primordial non-Gaussianity?

sources.title: Branes on charged dilatonic backgrounds: Selftuning, Lorentz violations and cosmology

evidence.text: Can charged dilatonic bulk backgrounds support brane cosmologies and flat self-tuning branes while avoiding naked singularities or exotic matter, and what gravitational Lorentz violations follow from their asymmetric warping?

sources.title: Bouncing brane cosmologies from warped string compactifications

evidence.text: Can a D3-brane moving through a smooth warped string compactification experience a controlled, spatially flat bouncing cosmology with four-dimensional gravity, and how would a brane observer describe it using a four-dimensional action?

sources.title: Sidestepping the cosmological constant with football shaped extra dimensions

evidence.text: Can stabilized, factorizable extra dimensions with explicit brane sources absorb brane vacuum energy into their internal geometry while keeping the four-dimensional branes flat, and what cosmological-constant tuning remains?

sources.title: The Fate of four-dimensions

evidence.text: Can gravitational theories with extra dimensions support stable four-dimensional de Sitter vacua, and could present acceleration instead represent a radion rolling toward decompactification?

sources.title: M / string theory, S-branes and accelerating universe

evidence.text: Can S-brane-inspired hyperbolic compactification supply realistic late-time dark energy after adding matter, while retaining a viable four-dimensional interpretation? Can the relation between dark energy and effective dimensionality address cosmic coincidence?

sources.title: More on tachyon cosmology in de Sitter gravity

evidence.text: Can a rolling tachyon coupled to four-dimensional de Sitter gravity produce inflation and late acceleration, and what restrictions follow for the input cosmological constant, initial conditions and compactification volume?

sources.title: Mirage cosmology

evidence.text: Can a universe brane moving through higher-dimensional bulk fields acquire an induced cosmology that resembles expansion driven by brane matter? How do world-volume energy and apparent initial singularities enter this description?

sources.title: Orientiworld

evidence.text: Can infinite-volume brane-world scenarios be embedded in string theory with chiral matter and quantum-induced four-dimensional gravity, potentially separating a TeV string scale from the four-dimensional Planck scale?

sources.title: Towards an Explicit Model of D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: Integrate the known throat contribution to a gluing cutoff, then parameterize inaccessible bulk geometry. This gives leading-volume relations; interpreting a fluxed D7 gauge coupling additionally requires checking its magnetic contribution.

sources.title: Inflation from wrapped branes

evidence.text: Pull back the ten-dimensional fields, evaluate the D5 determinant, integrate the wrapped sphere and normalize the radial kinetic term. The simplified output applies to the specified unfluxed embedding with small NS correction.

sources.title: De Sitter brane-world, localization of gravity, and the cosmological constant

evidence.text: Solve the warped higher-dimensional Einstein equations and integrate the gravitational action over extra coordinates. The resulting warped-volume integrals determine the four-dimensional Planck coefficient and cosmological term.

sources.title: Accelerating internal dimensions and nonzero positive cosmological constant

evidence.text: Internal Einstein equations are contracted using N=h^{mn}∂/∂h^{mn} and metric-homogeneous potential classes NVn=nVn. Without metric derivatives in V, the stated constraint is c=−χ^{1/2}(N−1)(N−3)V/3. Higher-derivative terms require an additional functional-variation contribution.

sources.title: Expanding Universe and Dynamical Compactification Using Yang-Mills Instantons

evidence.text: An exact boundary trajectory in the infinite-parameter limit is perturbed to linear order in a small parameter λ. Integrating Ḣ estimates e-folding, while the constraint determines the internal scale.

sources.title: Time-dependent compactification to de Sitter space: a no-go theorem

evidence.text: The authors compute geometric energy-condition expressions and use the integrated Einstein-frame constraint to obtain ⟨X⟩=0 and ⟨Ẋ⟩=−⟨X²⟩. The latter identity prevents replacing the average of Ẋ by zero.

sources.title: Multigravity and the cosmological constant

evidence.text: Can multigravity admit flat backgrounds with arbitrary cosmological constants, including Planck-scale values, without tuning potential parameters? The paper contrasts finite chains with a genuinely infinite tower of interacting spin-2 fields.

sources.title: Statistical Anisotropy from Vector Curvaton in D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: Can a D-brane worldvolume vector implement the vector curvaton mechanism and generate measurable statistical anisotropy in the curvature power spectrum and bispectrum?

sources.title: Radiative stability of tiny cosmological constant from the swampland and quantized compactification

evidence.text: What changes when the three-dimensional tensor component of a circle-compactified four-dimensional metric varies along the circle? The paper studies this dependence in Einstein gravity coupled to Standard Model matter rather than discarding it in the reduction.

sources.title: Constraints on Wrapped DBI Inflation in a Warped Throat

evidence.text: Can a relativistic D5- or D7-brane wrapped on an internal cycle generate allowed inflationary observables within a stabilized warped compactification?

sources.title: Ghost-Free Stable Minkowski Vacua in Lovelock Compactifications on Irreducible Symmetric Spaces

evidence.text: Can higher-dimensional Lovelock gravity compactified on a compact irreducible symmetric space produce a locally ghost-free four-dimensional Minkowski vacuum, and can its radius modulus be isolated from competing negative-energy configurations?

sources.title: A Strong Scalar Weak Gravity Conjecture and Some Implications

evidence.text: Can a three-dimensional analogue of the scalar bound constrain the infrared radion potential of a circle-compactified Standard Model?

sources.title: Dark Energy, Inflation and Extra Dimensions

evidence.text: What restrictions does four-dimensional accelerated expansion impose on higher-dimensional compactifications, including the evolution of moduli and the distribution and time dependence of NEC-violating sources?

sources.title: A Study of accelerating cosmologies from superstring / M theories

evidence.text: Can parameters in time-dependent vacuum, SM2-brane, and SD2-brane compactifications substantially enlarge transient accelerated expansion? Which internal curvatures permit it, and when is the ten-dimensional description trustworthy?

sources.title: Analyzing the general conditions for modulus stabilization in a warped braneworld

evidence.text: Under specified brane boundary conditions, how does the bulk scalar potential determine whether the radion stabilizes, and can geometric brane-world sum rules estimate the stabilized interbrane separation?

sources.title: Quintessence and the Swampland: The Parametrically Controlled Regime of Moduli Space

evidence.text: Can the weak-coupling or large-volume runaway of a Calabi–Yau compactification provide slowly evolving dark energy? The paper tests the scalar-potential gradient in the combined dilaton and Kähler sector, rather than searching for a positive stationary vacuum.

sources.title: The dark dimension and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can the proposed compactification stabilize the mesoscopic radius, maintain positive slowly varying energy, and suppress radion-mediated fifth forces?

sources.title: Quintessence and the Swampland: The Numerically Controlled Regime of Moduli Space

evidence.text: Can string compactifications realize dynamical dark energy where finite-order calculations remain reliable? The paper studies finite, large dilaton and volume rather than an uncontrolled order-one bulk or a strict asymptotic boundary.

sources.title: Dark energy, extra dimensions, and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can an explicit compactification produce a stable NEC-violating component whose dynamics follow the four-dimensional matter–dark-energy transition while satisfying cosmological observations?

sources.title: A no-go for no-go theorems prohibiting cosmic acceleration in extra dimensional models

evidence.text: Which assumptions underlie the reviewed NEC-based restrictions on four-dimensional acceleration in extra-dimensional models, and can an unnecessary metric restriction, boundary sources or the observer's metric invalidate their claimed generality?

sources.title: Four-Dimensional Null Energy Condition as a Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can a hierarchy of quantum corrections in an M-theory completion constrain the effective stress tensor of external four-dimensional cosmology, even when the higher-dimensional sources violate energy conditions?

sources.title: Inflationary scenario from higher curvature warped spacetime

evidence.text: Can the radion potential induced by five-dimensional R+αR² gravity drive early accelerated expansion on the visible brane, end inflation in finite time, and yield suitable e-fold counts, scalar spectral index, and tensor-to-scalar ratio?

sources.title: Can string theory avoid cosmological singularities?

evidence.text: Under what matter and dilaton conditions can a spatially flat, homogeneous, isotropic four-dimensional universe avoid cosmological curvature singularities, and could strong-coupling solitonic branes provide those conditions?

sources.title: Novel modulus stabilization mechanism in higher dimensional <math display="inline"><mrow><mrow><mi>f</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>R</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> gravity

evidence.text: Can a quadratic higher-curvature correction to a five-dimensional Randall–Sundrum geometry stabilize the original metric's radion without an externally introduced stabilizing field, while retaining a warped explanation of the gauge hierarchy?

sources.title: Brane gases in the early universe

evidence.text: Does including fundamental branes beyond strings preserve the proposed avoidance of the initial cosmological singularity and selection of at most three large spatial dimensions? Can the resulting brane relic problem be resolved dynamically?

sources.title: Cosmological perturbations from five-dimensional inflation

evidence.text: What scalar, entropy, tensor and vector primordial spectra arise from slow-roll five-dimensional inflation with one expanding compact dimension, and how does their brane-observed scale dependence differ across the compactification scale?

sources.title: The inheritance of energy conditions: Revisiting no-go theorems in string compactifications

evidence.text: Under which field-content and compactification assumptions do higher-dimensional null, strong, weak, and dominant energy conditions imply their lower-dimensional counterparts, thereby excluding cosmological backgrounds that violate those conditions?

sources.title: Brane cosmology and the self-tuning of the cosmological constant

evidence.text: What cosmological histories arise in holographic self-tuning braneworld theories at fixed UV sources, and can evolving branes approach flat self-tuning vacua or weakly curved de Sitter geometries?

sources.title: Constraints on String Cosmology

evidence.text: Can intrinsically stringy higher-derivative interactions violate the strong energy condition sufficiently to permit four-dimensional acceleration in heterotic compactifications with no time-dependent scalar fields?

sources.title: New no-go theorems for cosmic acceleration with extra dimensions

evidence.text: Under which geometric, dynamical, and higher-dimensional energy-condition assumptions must four-dimensional accelerated expansion from warped compactification be transient, and how does its maximum duration depend on the equation of state and number of extra dimensions?

sources.title: Accelerating cosmologies from M / string theory compactifications

evidence.text: Can time-dependent compactification of gravity coupled to a dilaton and n-form flux produce an accelerating, spatially flat four-dimensional Einstein-frame universe, extending the vacuum compactification construction?

sources.title: Time dependent string compactification: towards bouncing cosmology

evidence.text: Can time-dependent compactification with constant lower-dimensional Newton constant permit external NEC violation and a nonsingular bounce while respecting the higher-dimensional condition motivated by worldsheet symmetry?

sources.title: A Note on accelerating cosmologies from compactifications and S branes

evidence.text: How does a four-dimensional radion description explain transient acceleration in time-dependent compactifications and S-brane cosmologies, and what limits their usefulness for inflation or late-time acceleration?

sources.title: Stringy multifield quintessence and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can curved two-field dynamics from string compactifications reproduce the observed dark-energy epoch after fluid matter domination, while remaining stable against the growth of charged inhomogeneities?

sources.title: Cosmological space-times from negative tension brane backgrounds

evidence.text: Can hyperbolic and planar Einstein–dilaton–Maxwell backgrounds be interpreted as fields of negative-tension branes, and support bouncing cosmological regions with physically meaningful horizons, charges and thermodynamics?

sources.title: Dark energy, Ricci-nonflat spaces, and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a time-dependent Salam-Sezgin compactification explain a recent accelerated epoch while escaping constraints derived for a restricted class of extra-dimensional geometries and satisfying the reported dark-energy observations?

sources.title: Exponentially large extra dimensions

evidence.text: Can a light six-dimensional scalar with an unsuppressed cubic coupling generate logarithmic radion potentials, exponentially large compactification radii and a radiatively stable ultralight radion with acceptable gravitational and cosmological effects?

sources.title: Relaxing to three dimensions

evidence.text: Can cosmological dilution and annihilation of a higher-dimensional brane population select structures supporting three apparent spatial dimensions, through a dynamical 'relaxation principle' based on their late-time filling fraction?

sources.title: Eternal acceleration from M-theory

evidence.text: Can time-dependent dimensional reduction of higher-dimensional vacuum spacetimes produce eternal accelerated expansion in the conformal Einstein frame, and how does existence depend on dimension and spatial curvature?

sources.title: The Ekpyrotic universe: Colliding branes and the origin of the hot big bang

evidence.text: Can a slowly moving bulk brane colliding with the visible boundary produce a hot universe, address horizon, flatness and monopole problems, and generate nearly scale-invariant density perturbations without inflation?

sources.title: Oxidised cosmic acceleration

evidence.text: Which higher-dimensional energy conditions obstruct four-dimensional Einstein-frame acceleration, including time-dependent compactifications and expansion with w > −1, and when can its duration be bounded?

sources.title: Late-time Cosmic Acceleration from Compactification

evidence.text: Do higher-dimensional energy conditions exclude late-time accelerated Einstein-frame FLRW expansion when the compact space and warp factor depend on time, and what restrictions remain on the effective fluid and decompactification?

sources.title: Cosmic acceleration and M-theory

evidence.text: Can time-dependent compactifications of classical String/M-theory supergravity produce accelerating four-dimensional cosmologies despite the SEC no-go theorem, and when is acceleration transient, unavoidable, or compatible with absence of a future event horizon?

sources.title: The Landscape, the Swampland and the Era of Precision Cosmology

evidence.text: Can hyperbolic compactification provide acceptable four-dimensional acceleration without stabilizing its volume modulus?

sources.title: Dark energy, Ricci-nonflat spaces, and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can sphere and dilaton evolution generate a four-dimensional cosmology with a coupled dark sector? The setting retains a monopole-supported S² and two rolling scalar combinations rather than assuming a static Ricci-flat compactification.

sources.title: Accelerating cosmologies from S-branes

evidence.text: Can the Townsend–Wohlfarth accelerating vacuum cosmology be recovered from the author's earlier S-brane solutions, and which internal curvatures permit analogous four-dimensional acceleration with S-brane fields present?

sources.title: Inflationary universe in $F(R)$ gravity with antisymmetric tensor fields and their suppression during its evolution

evidence.text: Can higher-curvature gravity allow an initially significant Kalb–Ramond field, support inflation with a finite exit, and dynamically suppress its later observable effects in four dimensions and in a five-dimensional braneworld?

sources.title: Bispectrum from five-dimensional inflation

evidence.text: What scalar bispectrum does single-field five-dimensional inflation produce for an observer localized on a 3-brane, and can its momentum dependence and squeezed limit distinguish it from four-dimensional inflation?

sources.title: De Sitter and Anti-de Sitter branes in self-tuning models

evidence.text: How does dynamically selected brane curvature depend on boundary curvature, and can it be parametrically small in brane Planck units without tuning model parameters?

sources.title: Dark energy, Ricci-nonflat spaces, and the Swampland

evidence.text: How does internal-space evolution constrain four-dimensional acceleration and Newton's constant? The reviewed construction answers this only for a compact internal metric conformally related to a specified Ricci-flat reference geometry.

sources.title: de Sitter swampland bound in the Dirac-Born-Infeld inflation model

evidence.text: Can a speed-limited radial brane produce accelerated expansion on a potential that need not be canonically flat? The DBI square root determines the kinetic response while the AdS warp factor fixes its position dependence.

sources.title: Hyperbolic space cosmologies

evidence.text: Can time-dependent compactification on products of hyperbolic and flat spaces produce more sustained four-dimensional acceleration, particularly when the large spatial dimensions also have negative curvature and form-field backgrounds are allowed?

sources.title: Warm DBI inflation with constant sound speed

evidence.text: The DBI kinetic term limits radial brane velocity and permits scalar perturbations to propagate below light speed. The effective background contains one homogeneous scalar in flat FRW spacetime.

sources.title: Accelerating cosmologies from compactification

evidence.text: Can a time-dependent compact internal space yield four-dimensional accelerated expansion in Einstein frame from higher-dimensional gravity, circumventing the no-go theorem for time-independent compactifications?

sources.title: Stringy realization of a small and positive cosmological constant in dark bubble cosmology

evidence.text: Can a rotating D3-brane construction embed dark bubble cosmology in type IIB string theory, and can a WGC-motivated departure from critical brane tension produce a small positive four-dimensional cosmological constant?

sources.title: Modification of the laws of gravity in the DGP model by the presence of a second DGP brane

evidence.text: How does adding a second parallel brane with a localized gravitational kinetic term change static gravitational interactions in DGP, and what might this imply for galactic forces and black-hole species arguments?

sources.title: Braneworld effective field theories — holography, consistency and conformal effects

evidence.text: Can exactly localized braneworld matter arise continuously from five-dimensional fields, meaning convergence of their quantum effective actions and correlators? What consistency issues and observable effects distinguish the two descriptions?

sources.title: Dark bubbles: decorating the wall

evidence.text: How do localized brane matter and stretched bulk strings backreact on an expanding shellworld, and can brane bending and a holographically prescribed graviton propagator consistently reproduce four-dimensional gravity?

sources.title: Cosmological history after higher dimensional inflation

evidence.text: What post-inflationary history can connect uniform higher-dimensional inflation to low-temperature standard cosmology while preserving the observed primordial spectrum, solving the horizon problem and avoiding excessive bulk-graviton production?

sources.title: Deriving the Gibbons-Maldacena-Nunez no-go theorem from the Raychaudhuri equation

evidence.text: For accelerating external FRW geometry with static compact internal directions, does the null Raychaudhuri equation require higher-dimensional NEC violation, or does it recover the integrated SEC obstruction associated with the GMN no-go theorem?

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: Can a warped string compactification support positive four-dimensional curvature with controlled quantum corrections? The paper asks whether external deformations suffice or whether internal geometry and fluxes must also evolve.

sources.title: Universal accelerating cosmologies from 10d supergravity

evidence.text: Which universal, time-dependent compactifications of ten-dimensional Type IIA supergravity yield four-dimensional accelerated expansion, and when can acceleration be eternal, recurrent, nonsingular, or have a parametrically adjustable number of e-foldings?

sources.title: Curing with Hemlock: Escaping the swampland using instabilities from string theory

evidence.text: How can massive four-dimensional matter arise on the expanding wall? The construction uses outward radial bulk strings whose endpoints appear as particles, with a homogeneous distribution furnishing the cosmological matter sector.

sources.title: Dark dimension, the swampland, and the origin of cosmic rays beyond the Greisen-Zatsepin-Kuzmin barrier

evidence.text: Could small-scale hidden-brane structure provide a gravitational analogue of diffraction radiation and drain energy from UHECRs moving on the visible Standard Model brane?

sources.title: Diluting cosmological constant in infinite volume extra dimensions

evidence.text: Can gravity becoming higher-dimensional at cosmic distances dilute the four-dimensional curvature produced by a large brane vacuum energy, while retaining observable four-dimensional gravity and radiative stability?
